<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 2.1.2 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* Use Health Connect's daily totals for steps, distance and active energy by @strobeskinzzz in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1391
* Translations update from Hosted Weblate by @weblate in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1388
* Gym mode: add optional sticky set values by @BrianHotopp in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1290
* Gym mode: show upcoming set on timer pages, fix editing logged sets, persist rest timers by @BrianHotopp in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1289
* Don't lose a workout in gym mode when leaving it or when the app is killed by @andratwiro in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1280
* Add notifications while the app is in gym mode by @rolandgeider in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1405
### Dependencies
* Bump shared_preferences from 2.5.5 to 2.5.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1396
* Bump drift from 2.35.1 to 2.35.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1394
* Bump build_runner from 2.16.1 to 2.16.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1392
* Bump material_ui from 1.5.0 to 1.6.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1393
* Bump cupertino_icons from 1.0.9 to 2.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1395
* Bump fl_chart from 1.2.0 to 1.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1403
* Bump equatable from 2.1.0 to 3.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1402

## New Contributors
* @strobeskinzzz made their first contribution in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1391
* @BrianHotopp made their first contribution in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1290
* @andratwiro made their first contribution in https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/pull/1280

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wger-project/flutter/compare/2.1.1...2.1.2

detail.readme:
# Mobile app for wger wger is a free, open-source flutter application that manages and tracks/logs your exercises and personal workouts, weight, and diet plans. This is the mobile app written with Flutter, it talks via REST with the main server. If you want to contribute, hop on the Discord server and say hi!

## Installation [](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.wger.flutter) [](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.wger.flutter/) [](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wger-workout-manager/id6502226792) [](https://flathub.org/apps/de.wger.flutter) ## Developing and contributing Our goal is to build an awesome and flexible fitness and nutrition manager, along with a comprehensive list of exercises and ingredients, all released under a free license. For this, we’d love your help! Whether it’s code, translations, exercises or reporting issues and ideas, check out our [contribution guide](https://wger.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing.html) to get started. A huge thank you to everyone who has contributed so far! ❤️ See the full list in [AUTHORS.md](AUTHORS.md). **TLDR** ```bash flutter run ``` This is a regular flutter application, so there's no magic. You will need a backend for this, so feel free to use the test server for this (the db is reset daily): * URL: `https://dev.wger.de` * username: `user` * password: `flutteruser` ## Translation Translate the app to your language on [Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/wger/). [![translation status](https://hosted.weblate.org/widgets/wger/-/mobile/multi-blue.svg)](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/wger/) ## Contact Feel free to get in touch if you found this useful or if something didn't behave as expected. We can't fix what we don't know about, so please report liberally. If you're not sure if something is a bug or not, feel free to file a bug anyway. * **Discord:** * **Issue tracker:** * **Mastodon:** ## License The application is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License 3 or later (AGPL 3+) with an app store exception. As additional permission under section 7, you are allowed to distribute the software through an app store, even if that store has restrictive terms and conditions that are incompatible with the AGPL, provided that the source is also available under the AGPL with or without this permission through a channel without those restrictive terms and conditions. The initial exercise and ingredient data is licensed additionally under one of the Creative Commons licenses, see the individual exercises for more details.
